overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Medford School Committee member Jenny Graham about her first term, key district initiatives, equity in transportation, and the city's pandemic response. Graham outlined her priorities for strategic planning, vocational education, and district infrastructure ahead of the upcoming election.

items.title: Introduction and Favorite Local Spots
items.summary: Danielle Balocca introduced School Committee member Jenny Graham, who shared her favorite local Medford coffee shops and restaurants.

items.title: Background and Path to the School Committee
items.summary: Jenny Graham detailed her transition into municipal leadership through PTO fundraising, founding the Citywide Elementary Alliance, and serving on the superintendent search committee.

items.title: District Strategic Planning and Budgeting
items.summary: Jenny Graham described creating a district strategic plan to align budget allocations with foundational student needs and district goals.

items.title: Vocational and Academic Pathways
items.summary: Jenny Graham discussed expanding educational options at Medford High School by investing in vocational programs and hiring additional technical staff.

items.title: Equity and Student Transportation Initiatives
items.summary: Jenny Graham outlined efforts to improve educational equity, including eliminating student transport fees and piloting free MBTA bus passes.

items.title: Community Values and Personal Background
items.summary: Jenny Graham shared her appreciation for Medford's diversity and civic opportunities, as well as personal background and advice.

items.title: Pandemic Response and Facilities Maintenance
items.summary: Jenny Graham reviewed the district's COVID-19 protocols, pooled testing, weekly communications, and accelerated building repairs.

items.title: Conclusion and Show Information
items.summary: Danielle Balocca concluded the interview and shared subscription details and show notes for the podcast.
